author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: MINIX has listed the N304-AI, a compact mini PC based on Intel’s Core 3 304 processor with integrated Intel Graphics and an Intel AI Boost NPU. title: MINIX mini PC uses 5-core Intel Wildcat Lake processor with 24-TOPS AI performance
